name: CyberArk
strengths: Strong brand in security buying centers
sailpoint_advantages: Unified governance across cloud and on-prem
displacement_angle: PAM secures the few privileged accounts; SailPoint governs access for everyone. You need both, and governance is the gap.
common_objections: We standardized on CyberArk for privileged access

name: Saviynt
